name: smwsprites-brown-checkerboard-line-guided-platform-v1
title: Brown/Checkerboard Line-Guided Platform v1.1
description:
This is a disassembly of sprite 63 in SMW, the brown/checkerboard line-guided platform. The extra bit determines which tilemap and interaction size it will use.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

v1.1
-----
Support for LM3 exlevel settings. Only works with pixi 1.2.4+
